how: Kept by hand. Read on 22 Nov 2026 from each studio's or hotel's own website: Treehouse BDA (home page class list), Spirit House (Autumn 2026 schedule page), Grotto Bay (wellness classes page), Explore In (service pages), Shamana Circle and Salt Yoga (contact details only, because their timetables sit inside booking apps that could not be read). Facebook and Instagram were not read. Days in sessions are 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. Teachers are given by first name as the studios publish them, and no private phone numbers or emails are kept here. After review_after the build log warns and the page says details may be out of date.

places.name: Treehouse BDA
places.price: Drop in $25. Beginner's pack $69 for two weeks of any classes. 10 classes $225.
places.book: Book and pay online before class, through the links on their site.
places.note: Yoga, meditation, sound baths and qigong. Full timetable on this page.

places.name: Spirit House
places.price: Most classes $25 drop in. Class cards from each teacher.
places.book: Each teacher takes their own bookings. Contacts are on the schedule page.
places.note: Independent teachers share the space. Autumn 2026 timetable on this page, plus sound baths and circles.

places.name: Shamana Circle Studio
places.book: The Shamana Circle app, or the schedule page on their site.
places.note: Yoga, pilates and barre, more than 40 classes a week, with prenatal and postpartum classes. Their timetable is in their booking app, so it is not listed here. Their site names a final class, The Last Dance, on 24 December 2026.

places.name: Salt Yoga
places.note: Classes in Hamilton and at outdoor spots with a sea view, and paddleboard yoga in summer. Their timetable is in their booking app, so it is not listed here.

places.name: Explore In, Waterfront Hub
places.price: Class series from $160. Private classes from $100.
places.note: Class series such as Yin and Foundation, private classes, and outdoor classes at the forts. Open to the public. Dates change by season, so check their site.

places.name: Grotto Bay Beach Resort
places.price: Rise and Renew $25 for hotel guests, $35 for visitors. Aqua yoga $25.
places.book: Pay by room charge or cash. Ask the hotel to confirm the class is on.
places.note: Open to people not staying at the hotel. Cave Yoga in the Cathedral Cave is run by Explore In as a private class: $140 for up to 3 people, 9am in winter.

places.name: Rosewood Bermuda
places.note: Morning wellbeing classes, Vinyasa and Slow Flow, for hotel guests and Tucker's Point Club members. Times are not published.

sessions.name: Midday Zen
sessions.note: Their page also shows 12 to 1pm, so check

events.name: Sound, Tea, Tarot, Meditation and Reflection
Full Moon Women's Circle and Cacao Ceremony

monthly: Treehouse also runs once a month sessions (sound bath journey, restorative yoga and reiki, R and B yoga with mocktails, qigong flow). Dates are on their site.
